functionality: Create Outsource Order, List/View Outsource Orders, Update Outsource Status
description: Outsourcing an accession test to an external performing lab. IMPORTANT SCHEMA GAP: there is no dedicated 'outsource order' table and no outsource-specific status column anywhere in the schema. This contract is built entirely from existing columns (accession_tests.performing_lab_id, test_master.outsource_test/outsource_center_id, outsource_center_master) and explicitly flags where that is insufficient.

reused_apis.note: The List/View operation below is the same accession_tests resource, filtered to outsourced rows - not a new table.

operations.operation: Create Outsource Order (Assign to Outsource Lab)
validation: accessionTestId must exist and belong to organization + branch
performingLabId must reference an existing performing_lab_master row

response.message: Accession test assigned to outsource lab successfully

errors.condition: accessionTestId not found / not in organization+branch scope
performingLabId does not reference an existing lab

operations.schema_gap_note: There is no FK linking accession_tests (or performing_lab_master) to outsource_center_master, and no accession_tests column marking a specific line item as 'sent outsource' distinct from a normal in-house performing_lab_id reassignment. This endpoint can only record which lab will perform the test, using the existing performing_lab_id column - it cannot record which outsource_center_master row the order was placed with, an order/reference number, dispatch date, or expected return date. DB/Schema confirmation required if that level of tracking is needed.

validation: returns accession_tests rows where test_master.outsource_test = true OR accession_tests.performing_lab_id is set to a non-default lab

errors.condition: organizationId or branchId does not exist

body.outsourceStatus: enum, required - intended values: SENT | RESULT_RECEIVED | CANCELLED (see schema_gap_note)

response.error: Outsource status tracking is not supported by the current schema

operations.schema_gap_note: No column anywhere (accession_tests, test_master, performing_lab_master, outsource_center_master) stores an outsource-specific status such as SENT / RESULT_RECEIVED. accession_tests.sample_status (PENDING, COLLECTED, RECEIVED, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, REJECTED, plus sample_status_master-driven IN_TRANSIT, RECOLLECTION_REQUESTED per API-047's notes) is the closest existing field and can be used as an interim proxy via the already-existing update-sample-status endpoint (API-048), but it does not distinguish an outsourced test from an in-house one. DB/Schema confirmation required: add an outsource_status column (or a dedicated outsource_order table) before this operation can be implemented as specified.

notes: Net-new contract; no e2e-validation or api_contracts_test coverage exists yet. outsource_center_master itself also has no create/list/view API of its own anywhere in the existing 001-127 range - only referenced here as a read-only join target.
